purpose: Verify VMS creates authoritative digital visitor records replacing manual entry.
preconditions: Visitor pre-registers with valid contact and visit details.
action_or_input: Submit visit registration via VMS endpoint.
expected_result: Authoritative Visitor and VisitRequest record created in system with PENDING status.

purpose: Verify operational records are queryable through authoritative registry.
preconditions: Visit requests exist in system.
action_or_input: Query visitor registry with authorized role.
expected_result: Registry returns complete digital visit history without manual log dependency.

purpose: Verify Super Admin can assign VMS operational roles with defined scope and duration.
preconditions: Authenticated user is Super Admin; target staff user exists.
action_or_input: Assign Security Personnel role for Zone 1 with expiration date.
expected_result: Role assignment persisted with zone scope and valid time window.

purpose: Verify pending operational work is handed off when roles are reassigned.
preconditions: Staff member A has pending visit reviews.
action_or_input: Reassign role and pending work queue to staff member B.
expected_result: Pending reviews successfully transferred to staff member B.

purpose: Verify non-Super Admin cannot assign or modify VMS operational roles.
preconditions: Authenticated user is regular Host or Visitor.
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden; role assignment rejected.

purpose: Verify VMS treats Campus ID and external modules as external collaborators without foreign keys.
preconditions: External host ID provided in pre-registration.
action_or_input: Create visit linking host by username/string ID without direct DB foreign key.
expected_result: Visit created referencing external host identifier cleanly.

purpose: Verify VMS accepts event/hostel coordination metadata via designated boundary payloads.
preconditions: Event ID or hostel booking reference provided.
expected_result: External reference stored in visit metadata without cross-module FK.

purpose: Verify Super Admin can grant VIP permissions with fast-track check-in.
preconditions: Super Admin is logged in; visitor profile exists.
action_or_input: Flag visitor profile as VIP with designated override reason.
expected_result: VIP flag active; visitor eligible for auto-approval and expedited gate clearance.

purpose: Verify VIP visit pre-registration bypasses manual host approval.
preconditions: Visitor has active VIP designation.
action_or_input: Submit visit registration for VIP visitor.
expected_result: Visit transitions directly to APPROVED / Pass Issued without host approval delay.

purpose: Verify operational actions (approval, gate checks, overrides) produce immutable audit logs.
preconditions: Security gate check performed.
action_or_input: Log gate check-in event for pass.
expected_result: Audit log entry created with timestamp, actor, pass ID, and gate location.

purpose: Verify Security Admin can retrieve audit trails filtered by date and entity.
preconditions: Audit logs exist in database.
expected_result: Returns list of audit events matching query parameters.

purpose: Verify Admin can create and version access policies (visiting hours, max duration).
preconditions: Admin user authenticated.
action_or_input: Create Policy v1 (visiting hours 08:00-20:00, max duration 8h).
expected_result: Policy saved with version 1, marked draft or published.

purpose: Verify runtime gate checks use only the latest active published policy version.
preconditions: Policy v1 published; v2 is in draft.
action_or_input: Validate pass during hours permitted by v1 but excluded by draft v2.
expected_result: Validation succeeds based on active published policy v1.

purpose: Verify Admin can add individuals to blacklist with name, ID number, and justification.
preconditions: Admin user authenticated.
action_or_input: POST /api/vms/blacklist/ with ID document and reason.
expected_result: BlacklistEntry created with ACTIVE status.

purpose: Verify visitor registration matching blacklisted ID is rejected immediately.
preconditions: Active blacklist entry exists for ID 'ABC1234567'.
expected_result: HTTP 400/409 error; registration rejected with blacklist alert.

purpose: Verify temporary safe-list entry allows registration for otherwise flagged visitor.
preconditions: Visitor matches watchlist but has active temporary safe-list entry from Admin.
expected_result: Registration permitted; safe-list bypass logged in audit trail.

purpose: Verify Admin can generate visitor statistics and traffic analytics.
preconditions: Multiple check-in and check-out records exist.
expected_result: Returns counts of current on-site visitors, completed visits, peak hours.

purpose: Verify Admin can upload bulk visitor list for campus events.
preconditions: Admin user authenticated; valid CSV/JSON list of attendees.
expected_result: All 5 visitors registered and batch pass generation initiated.

purpose: Verify pre-registration enforces mandatory fields (name, phone, host, purpose, ID).
preconditions: Visitor submits request missing host or contact details.
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request with validation errors indicating missing fields.

purpose: Verify system prevents duplicate overlapping visit requests for same visitor and date.
preconditions: Active approved visit exists for Visitor A today.
action_or_input: Submit second visit request for Visitor A for overlapping schedule.
expected_result: HTTP 409 Conflict; duplicate request rejected.

purpose: Verify visitor can track visit status and download QR pass once approved.
preconditions: Visit request is in APPROVED status.
expected_result: Returns digital pass details including secure token/QR payload and validity window.

purpose: Verify Host can approve or reject pending visit requests.
preconditions: Visit request pending approval for Host X.
action_or_input: Host X posts approval decision (APPROVE or REJECT).
expected_result: Visit transitions to APPROVED (pass generated) or REJECTED.

purpose: Verify Host can create pre-authorization for frequent visitor.
preconditions: Host authenticated.
action_or_input: POST /api/vms/pre-authorizations/ with visitor email and validity window.
expected_result: Pre-authorization saved; subsequent visits automatically approved.

purpose: Verify Security Personnel can validate pass at gate and check-in visitor.
preconditions: Visitor presents valid approved QR pass at main gate.
expected_result: Gate validation passes; visit status transitions to CHECKED_IN (on-site).

purpose: Verify gate check-in denies expired passes.
preconditions: Pass validity window ended 1 hour ago.
action_or_input: Attempt gate check-in with expired pass token.
expected_result: HTTP 400/422 validation failure; entry denied; event logged.

purpose: Verify Admin can authorize manual gate override with mandatory audit reason.
preconditions: Visitor cannot present QR pass due to dead phone battery.
expected_result: Override granted; check-in recorded with Admin identity and reason in audit trail.

purpose: Verify Security Personnel or Visitor self-checkout transitions visit to CHECKED_OUT.
preconditions: Visitor currently has CHECKED_IN status.
expected_result: Status updated to CHECKED_OUT; pass deactivated; checkout timestamp recorded.

purpose: Verify Security Personnel have real-time visibility into all on-site visitors.
preconditions: Two visitors checked in, one checked out.
expected_result: Returns list of exactly 2 on-site visitors with active zones and host details.

purpose: Verify system checks visitor zone authorization before granting zone entry.
preconditions: Visitor pass is authorized for 'Academic Block' only.
expected_result: Access denied; zone violation alert triggered and recorded.

purpose: Verify Admin can grant temporary time-boxed zone elevation.
preconditions: Visitor has standard access.
action_or_input: Admin POST /api/vms/zones/elevate/ for zone 'Server Room' valid for 2 hours.
expected_result: Temporary zone elevation active; subsequent access to Server Room allowed within 2h.

purpose: Verify Admin or Security Personnel can trigger emergency muster and snapshot on-site roster.
preconditions: Active on-site visitors exist.
expected_result: Emergency muster initiated; snapshot roster generated of all current on-site visitors.

purpose: Verify Security Personnel can mark accountability status (ACCOUNTED / UNACCOUNTED).
preconditions: Emergency muster active with roster of 3 visitors.
expected_result: Visitor 1 status updated to ACCOUNTED; remaining 2 remain UNACCOUNTED.

purpose: Verify offline gate check-in logs can be reconciled when connectivity is restored.
preconditions: Security gate app records offline check-in payload with signed timestamp.
expected_result: Batch events processed, validated against pass registry, and merged into live log.

purpose: Verify Security Personnel can register walk-in visitor at gate.
preconditions: Unscheduled visitor arrives at gate with valid ID document.
action_or_input: POST /api/vms/visits/walk-in/ with visitor ID and selected host.
expected_result: Walk-in visit created with WALK_IN pass type; host notification dispatched.

purpose: Verify Admin can provide contingency approval if host is unavailable for walk-in.
preconditions: Walk-in request pending host response past SLA window.
expected_result: Visit approved under contingency rules; pass activated for gate entry.

purpose: Verify Host or Admin can extend visit duration for on-site visitor.
preconditions: Visitor is checked in; approaching pass expiration.
expected_result: Pass valid_to extended by 2 hours; status remains CHECKED_IN.

purpose: Verify Host or Admin can terminate active visit early for security or scheduling reasons.
preconditions: Visitor currently on-site.
expected_result: Pass revoked immediately; visit marked TERMINATED_EARLY; security notified.

purpose: Verify pending visit requests expire automatically if host does not respond within timeout window.
preconditions: Visit request pending for > 24 hours (or configured timeout).
expected_result: Visit request transitioned to EXPIRED; visitor and host notified.

purpose: Verify system flags overstays and performs automatic checkout past daily cut-off.
preconditions: Visitor checked in yesterday did not check out.
expected_result: Visit transitioned to AUTO_CHECKED_OUT; flagged as overstay in security audit.
